title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Billing Calendar and Chargeable Days
content:
**Business office billing calendar — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** These terms are the same for all six accommodation tiers.

| Term | Setting for every tier |
|---|---|
| Billing period for room and board | Calendar month, billed in advance |
| Advance statement for a service month | Issues on day 25 of the month before |
| Due date of a month's advance charge | Day 10 of the service month |
| How chargeable days are counted | Midnight census |
| Day of admission | Chargeable |
| Day of discharge | Not chargeable |
| Day of death | Not chargeable |
| Admission month | The daily rate times the days from the admission date to month end |

**Worked reading (hypothetical).** For a service month of 30 days, the advance statement issues on day 25 of the month before and the charge is due on day 10 of the service month. A resident admitted on day 21 of a 30-day month is charged for days 21 through 30, that is 10 days, the admission day included. A resident who leaves on day 12 of a month was in the center at midnight on days 1 through 11; day 12 is not chargeable.
